description: Deterministic Wu Ming S2 isolation following the mixed solo discrepancy. WIP attacks with Wu Ming 3/3/3 and 500 T6 Lancers into minxxx's 340 T6 Marksmen. Because no Infantry or skill-damage jobs exist, Wu Ming S1 and S3 should be inert. With the exact current stats captured immediately beforehand, the configured S2 predicts +39; omitting S2 predicts -61; incorrectly allowing S3 to amplify normal attacks predicts +136; and incorrectly applying S1 to all troops predicts +137. These interpretations and decision rules are frozen before capture.
